data.description:
## Incident Overview
**Component:** sprint Phase E / shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md + agents' Startup 'Session HEAD Sync' block (worktree-session-head-sync.sh)
**Condition:** Orchestrator injects SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD into each sub-agent's prompt as TEXT lines per worktree-dispatch.md, but worktree-session-head-sync.sh reads them from the ENVIRONMENT (${SESSION_BRANCH:-}/${SESSION_HEAD:-}). Prompt text does not set sub-agent env vars.
**Observed Result:** The sync script sees SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD as unset, errors/skips, and the agent worktree remains based on origin/main (the Agent runtime's default) instead of the session HEAD. When origin/main has diverged from the session branch (common on long-lived sessions), every harvested worktree carries dozens of unrelated origin/main commits, forcing the orchestrator to manually strip drift (extract staged files -> reset --hard to session HEAD -> reapply) on nearly every task in epic dso-uvyl. Several agents self-reported 'session-head-sync errored (SESSION_BRANCH not set); merged SESSION_HEAD manually'.

## Reproduction
Run /dso:sprint on an epic whose session branch is behind origin/main; dispatch a worktree-isolated sub-agent; observe the agent's worktree git log contains origin/main commits not in the session branch.

## Expected Behavior
Sub-agent worktrees start from the session HEAD. Either (a) the orchestrator must export SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD into the sub-agent's environment (if the Agent tool supports env injection), or (b) worktree-session-head-sync.sh / the agent Startup block must parse SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD from the prompt body, or (c) worktree-dispatch.md must instruct agents to read them from the prompt and pass them to the sync script explicitly.

## Impact
Heavy per-task orchestrator overhead (manual drift-stripping), risk of harvesting unrelated main changes, and version/marker churn. Surfaced repeatedly across epic dso-uvyl (sprint session 2026-06-02/03).
data.title: [sprint/worktree-dispatch]: SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD injected as prompt text -> sub-agent worktrees base on origin/main, not session HEAD
